id: \rI am so so sick of the snow.
en: \rI am so so sick of the snow.
it: \rNe ho davvero, davvero abbastanza della neve.

id: \bI lost my Icy Rock around here somewhere. I think that's why it's always snowing.
en: \bI lost my Icy Rock around here somewhere. I think that's why it's always snowing.
it: \bHo perso la mia Rocciafredda da queste parti. Credo che sia per questo che nevica sempre.

id: Snowbelle City\nThe city of everlasting winter.
en: Snowbelle City\nThe city of everlasting winter.

id: \bSawyer: I've done it \PN. I've got my last badge. Now it's time for the Kalos League.
en: \bSawyer: I've done it \PN. I've got my last badge.  Now it's time for the Kalos League.
it: \bSawyer: Ce l'ho fatta, \PN. Ho ottenuto la mia ultima Medaglia. Ora è il momento della Lega di Kalos.

id: \bJust in case we don't get to battle each other, let's do it right now.
en: \bJust in case we don't get to battle each other, let's do it right now.
it: \bNel caso non riuscissimo a sfidarci là, facciamolo subito.

id: \bWith everything I've learned from you there is no way I'm going to lose. Let's meet in the finals \PN.
en: \bWith everything I've learned from you there is no way I'm going to lose. Let's meet in the finals \PN.
it: \bCon tutto quello che ho imparato da te, non c'è modo che io perda. Vediamoci in finale, \PN.

id: Tough as an iceberg, hot as a furnace.
en: Tough as an iceberg, hot as a furnace.
it: Duro come un iceberg, caldo come una fornace.

id: \rIt's so cold here. Some people believe it's because of the gym.
en: \rIt's so cold here. Some people believe it's because of the gym.
it: \rFa così freddo qui. Alcuni credono che sia colpa della Palestra.

id: \bToo many hills to climb. I should have just stayed home.
en: \bToo many hills to climb. I should have just stayed home.
it: \bTroppe colline da salire. Avrei fatto meglio a restare a casa.

id: \bWulfric has a secret weapon. He saves it for when he gets serious.
en: \bWulfric has a secret weapon. He saves it for when he gets serious.
it: \bEdel ha un'arma segreta. La tiene da parte per quando fa sul serio.

id: \bHere's a one of a kind item.
en: \bHere's a one of a kind item.
it: \bEcco uno strumento unico nel suo genere.
\bChe c'è? Ne hai già visto uno?
